source: The server's growth, rebirth and Mitama tables (DevilLVUpRateData, MitamaUnionBonusData, MitamaReunionBonusData, MitamaReunionSetBonusData, NPCBarterData), the client's texts, and comp_hack's rebirth rules

runes.name: Tiwaz
runes.text: Well-balanced growth, with a focus on Strength. Protected by Tiwaz, rune of War and Victory.

runes.name: Peorth
runes.text: Well-balanced growth, with a focus on Magic. Protected by Peorth, rune of Mystery and Secrets.

runes.name: Fehu
runes.text: Well-balanced growth, with a focus on Speed. Protected by Fehu, rune of Freedom and Change.

runes.name: Eihwaz
runes.text: Well-balanced growth, with a focus on Intelligence. Protected by Eihwaz, rune of Death and Protection.

runes.name: Uruz
runes.text: Extraordinary focus on Strength and Speed. Protected by Uruz, rune of Strength and Courage.

runes.name: Hagalaz
runes.text: Extraordinary focus on Strength and Magic. Protected by Hagalaz, rune of Storms and Destruction.

runes.name: Laguz
runes.text: Extraordinary focus on Magic and Speed. Protected by Laguz, rune of Exploration and Travel.

runes.name: Ansuz
runes.text: Growth revolving around Strength, Magic and Speed. Protected by Ansuz, rune of Language and Knowledge.

runes.name: Nauthiz
runes.text: Growth revolving around Magic, Intelligence and Speed. Protected by Nauthiz, rune of Poverty and Endurance.

runes.name: Ingwaz
runes.text: Growth revolving around Magic, Intelligence and Luck. Protected by Ingwaz, rune of Birth and Harvest.

runes.name: Sowilo
runes.text: Growth equally focused on all attributes. Protected by Sowilo, rune of the Sun and Life.

runes.name: Wyrd
runes.text: No noticeable growth until high levels due to the fate decreed by Wyrd, blank rune of Fate.
